name: Thin Wisps Fireworks Show
disable: DC 21 Acrobatics check to turn away from the explosions, or DC 25 Crafting check to identify the exact moment the fireworks will explode
routine: (1 action; visual) The Thin Wisps continue to launch fireworks until the dottari excruciator divisions are defeated. Each round, all creatures must succeed at a DC 24 Fortitude save save or be Dazzled and Deafened for 1 round (or Blinded and deafened for 1 round on a critical failure).

items.name: Let the Sparks Fly
items.text:
Trigger A non-dottari creature takes damage

---
Effect Thin Wisps fire off a series of fireworks as they rappel from the eaves on scarves. All creatures in area A must attempt a DC 24 Fortitude save save. On a failure, the target is Dazzled and Deafened until the end of its next turn (or Blinded and deafened on a critical failure). The hazard then rolls initiative.

text: Fashionable performers and revolutionaries rappel from the surrounding buildings on scarves.
